card.text: Kepler-37 b was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-37b"
sources.quote: Kepler-37b is an exoplanet orbiting the star Kepler-37 in the constellation Lyra.

introduction.text: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-37. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-37b"
sources.quote: As of February 2013, it is the smallest planet discovered around a main-sequence star, with a radius slightly greater than that of the Moon and slightly smaller than that of Mercury.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
